question: Use an LSTM neural network to predict daily ICU occupancy over the next 7 days using a sliding window of the past 21 days. Normalize the series with MinMaxScaler. Use the first 80% of sliding-window sequences for training and the remaining 20% as the test set. Architecture: two LSTM layers (64 units then 32 units, both ReLU) each followed by Dropout(0.2), then Dense(16, ReLU) and Dense(7) output. Train with Adam optimizer (MSE loss, batch_size=32) for up to 100 epochs using early stopping (patience=10, monitor val_loss) on a 20% internal validation split of training sequences. Report test RMSE.

files.eval_guideline: The single Test_RMSE value must be within 25% relative absolute error of the reference; row/column label phrasing may differ.
